notes.title: Public test is now the official version!
notes.content:
We're launching the public updated changes to the default game, which includes the new rendering and other changes!

Since this can present some incompatibilities, if you're experiencing troubles running the new patch, you can go to the game properties on steam, and select the "oldver" to use the previous version for now.

We're still working on the next patch, which should include more art and engine changes, and quality of life improvements, and fixing some bugs found in the last public test. Long term, we're working on significant gameplay changes! We're also taking into account your suggestions for other priority features to work on.

Thanks for riding!

notes.title: Tiny update: Streamliner Trainset test
notes.content:
Have you been playing our public test over the holidays? We snuck in a test version of an upcoming streamliner trainset on Christmas!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30772860/cae6b5813f4a33517b060c0f4d04ab6792e9b778.jpg[/img]

More feature updates and content coming in the new year!

How to Play:
Opt-in to our public test version!
[list]
[*]     Right click on TFC in your library (or select the Settings cog on the game page)
[*]     Select [i]Properties [/i]in the drop down menu
[*]     Under the properties tab, select [i]Betas[/i]
[*]     Change[i] Beta Participation[/i] drop down from [i]None [/i]to [i]publictest[/i]
[/list]

How to make sure your new version is ready and updated:
[list]
[*]     Go to properties tab [i]Installed Files[/i]
[*]     Then use the [i]'Verify integrity of game files' [/i]feature
[*]     In library the game should be named [i]Train Frontier Classic [publictest][/i]
[/list]

[i]Map: 'Leandro Rails Co' by Lensilver[/i]

notes.title: Train Frontier Classic Public Test Available Now!
notes.content:
[i]Is it true? A new update?[/i]

We've updated our old engine to a newer gen look! Going max settings might require a higher spec system (farewell xbox 360 specs), but we've also added a few more graphics options to fine tune game performance (try "Render Amount" on crowded maps!), and you can expect some optimizations later. Fortunately, the new and old TFC are compatible, so no need to worry just yet if your system can't yet run the new version, or you prefer the old look. There's a bunch of mostly minor changes added as well, but will lead up to much larger ones in the future.

[b]How to Play[/b]:
Opt-in to our public test version!
[list]
[*] Right click on TFC in your library (or select the Settings cog on the game page)
[*] Select [i]Properties[/i] in the drop down menu
[*] Under the properties tab [i]Betas[/i]
[*] Change [i]Beta Participation[/i] drop down from [i]None [/i]to [i]publictest[/i]
[/list]
Make sure your new version is ready and updated:
[list]
[*] Go to properties tab [i]Installed Files[/i]
[*] Then use the '[i]Verify integrity of game files[/i]' feature
[*] In library the game should be [i]Train Frontier Classic [publictest][/i]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30772860/ed18fab181e4dd9b5775943ec6664a5f268d5c5b.jpg[/img]
Maps: "City Central" by greatm8nate, "Frontier Federation" by Zuiho, "Double Header" by Enigma Genesis

notes.title: Workshop Map Spotlight - "TFC Mountain Division" by Trublemaker 12
notes.content:
This [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1480597557]map[/url] by Trublemaker 12, with deep mountain vistas and faraway skylines, highlights many in-the-works changes on the ol' Train Frontier rendering engine.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30772860/586637b5638307235b3c6e4ca775932204e80d7b.jpg[/img]

On top of a lot of visual, usability, and art updates, we're currently working on some core game changes we've wanted to do since the TFE days. The game won't be playable until it's finished, which is why were holding onto other changes (like the gfx update) until it's done. Thanks for your patience!

notes.title: New Steam Engine, Track Building Updates and More!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30772860/598741977e32a742f5d09bd3af3b0d547593fcf5.jpg[/img]

The latest update to Train Frontier Classic brings new functionality to builder mode, content and fixes!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30772860/f934e6f893b11911f732beafbaa20441867a9149.jpg[/img]
[h1]Prop and Track Building Updates[/h1]
We have a new prop building UI, including a quick swipeable prop list and the ability to select/copy placed props. Track building also has major improvements, including [b]reverse track branching[/b] and [b]live multiplayer track laying[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30772860/30b3bb5e003f1491d09ed5b8db49079cecd06acb.jpg[/img]
[h1]Car Limit Increase[/h1]
In other big news, we're testing a [b]raise on the maximum car limit[/b], and have doubled the amount of active cars! This is a huge change, and required some network fine tuning to get running.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
We've been trying to track down some of the bugs that have been reported since last update. We think we've nailed down one the huge freeze bugs. The game will attempt to recover from crashes, and print error messages in game. [b]You can help us fix bugs by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/713460/discussions/1/]posting in the support forums[/url] what the in-game error says (also include errorlog.txt in your game folder), and what you did to get the error![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30772860/80fad177ea3c53c6ec55213ea025e87f2e13ec9e.jpg[/img]
[h1] New Tank Engine[/h1]
A new 0-6-0 tank engine joins the Train Frontier line up! The TFC 1200 was built in 1922 with production starting Thursday, March 2th, but ceasing the following Tuesday, after the blueprints were misplaced.  Oops. Only three 1200s were ever produced in that time. Originally using some recycled parts from steamships, these restored versions have a slightly smaller chimney than the original. 

Look forward to some era-specific cars based on your suggestions!

notes.title: Extended Winter Sale! Workshop Support Almost Ready!
notes.content:
We were able to extend our EA Launch sale into Steam's Winter sale event -- so if you've wishlisted the game and were looking for a relaxing ride during your holiday break, grab it while it's cold!

Workshop support is ready for deployment, but we'd like the community to get their maps prepared for launch day! Expect workshop launch soon, within the next few weeks, or even sooner! More details to come.

notes.title: Many small updates!
notes.content:
We've been releasing small patches, including an overhauled conductor UI, builder UI improvements, multiplayer voice settings, and many small fixes.

There's also now an in game help overlay for new players unfamiliar with the features and hotkeys of the builder.

For more detailed guide information, check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1231177390]TFC Quick Start Guide[/url]!

Rather than large updates, we'll be pushing many small patches as time goes on, but there's new exciting features coming in the following weeks and months that we'll announce as they launch.
